q1.explanationZh: opera“歌剧”，复数 operas，appreciate operas“欣赏歌剧”。

q2.explanationZh: operate 既可作不及物动词“运转；动手术”，也可作及物动词“操作；经营”，operate on sb.“给某人动手术”。

q3.explanationZh: operate 去 e 加 -ion 构成名词 operation，have an operation“做手术”。

q4.explanationZh: operate 去 e 加 -or 表示人，operator“操作员；接线员”。

q5.explanationZh: opinion“意见；看法”，in my opinion“我认为”。

q7.explanationZh: opportunity“机会”，注意双写 p，结尾是 -tunity。

q8.explanationZh: oppose“反对”是及物动词，直接跟宾语；be opposed to 也表示“反对”。

q9.explanationZh: opposite 可作名词、形容词和副词，be opposite to“在……对面”。

q10.explanationZh: oppress“压迫”，注意双写 p 和结尾的 -ss。

q11.explanationZh: optimistic“乐观的”，反义词是 pessimistic“悲观的”。

q12.explanationZh: option“选择”，形容词 optional“任选的”。

q13.explanationZh: or 是连词，表示“或者”；用在祈使句后表示“否则”。

q15.explanationZh: orange“橙子；橙黄色”，以元音音素开头，前面用 an：an orange。

q16.explanationZh: orbit 作名词“轨道”，作动词“沿轨道运行”，orbit the sun“绕太阳运行”。

q17.explanationZh: orchestra“管弦乐队”，注意 ch 读 /k/。

q18.explanationZh: order 作名词“次序；秩序；命令”，作动词“命令；点（菜）”。

q19.explanationZh: order 加 -ly 构成形容词 orderly“整齐的”，注意它不是副词。

q21.explanationZh: organ“器官；风琴”，the organs of sight“视觉器官”。

q22.explanationZh: organ 加 -ic 构成形容词 organic“有机的”，organic food“有机食品”。

q23.explanationZh: organisation 是英式拼写，organization 是美式拼写，两种都对。

q24.explanationZh: organise 是英式拼写，organize 是美式拼写，两种都对。

q25.explanationZh: orient 作名词时常写作 the Orient“东方”；作动词“使适应”。

q26.explanationZh: origin“起源”，形容词 original，动词 originate。

q27.explanationZh: origin 加 -al 构成形容词 original“原先的；原创的”。

q29.explanationZh: orphan 加 -age 构成 orphanage“孤儿院”。

q30.explanationZh: other 可作形容词“其他的”，也可作代词：the other“（两者中的）另一个”，the others“其余的人或物”。

q31.explanationZh: otherwise“否则，不然”，由 other + wise 构成。

q32.explanationZh: ought to“应当”，后接动词原形，否定形式是 ought not to。

q34.explanationZh: operate on sb.“给某人动手术”，介词用 on。

q35.explanationZh: have a good/high opinion of“认为……好”，have a poor/low opinion of“认为……不好”。

q36.explanationZh: give/express one’s opinion“表达观点”，动词用 give 或 express 都可以。

q37.explanationZh: be of the opinion that ...“认为……”，后面接 that 从句。

q38.explanationZh: in one’s opinion“据某人看来”，如 in my opinion“我认为”。

q40.explanationZh: ought to have done 表示“本该做而实际没做”，带有责备或遗憾的语气。

accept: have/take/seize the opportunity to do/of doing sth.
have the opportunity to do sth.
have the opportunity of doing sth.
take the opportunity to do sth.
take the opportunity of doing sth.
seize the opportunity to do sth.
seize the opportunity of doing sth.

q41.explanationZh: have/take/seize the opportunity to do sth. 或 of doing sth.“有机会做某事”，注意 to 后接动词原形，of 后接动名词。

accept: given the opportunity (= if sb. has the opportunity)

q42.explanationZh: given the opportunity“有机会的话”，相当于 if sb. has the opportunity。

q43.explanationZh: be opposite to“在……对面；与……相反”，介词用 to。

q44.explanationZh: in order“按顺序；合适”；注意与 out of order“坏了”区分。

q45.explanationZh: out of order“出故障，坏了”，如 The machine is out of order.

q46.explanationZh: in good (working) order“处于良好状态”，working 可以省略。

accept: in order that .../in order to do ...

q47.explanationZh: in order that 后接从句，in order to 后接动词原形，都表示“为了”。

q48.explanationZh: other than“除了；不同于”，常用于否定句。

q49.explanationZh: “接线员会为你接通电话”，put sb. through“接通电话”，主语是人，用名词 operator。

q50.explanationZh: “我觉得被热得透不过气”，feel 后接形容词 oppressed“感到压抑的”。

q51.explanationZh: “今天是很平常的一天”，修饰名词 day 用形容词 ordinary。

q52.explanationZh: orient oneself“使自己适应（环境）”，to 后用动词原形。

q53.explanationZh: operate on sb.“给某人动手术”，be 后用过去分词 operated 构成被动语态。

q54.explanationZh: will 后接动词原形，organise“组织”；美式拼写 organize 也对。

q55.explanationZh: order 作动词“点（菜）”，叙述过去的事用过去式 ordered。

q56.explanationZh: “比赛中，你的对手和你一样怕你”，your 后用名词 opponent“对手”。

q57.explanationZh: oppose“反对”，后面直接接宾语，叙述过去的事用过去式 opposed。

q58.explanationZh: original novels“原版小说”，修饰名词用形容词 original。

q59.sampleAnswer: You cannot do everything as well as certain other people do.
references: You cannot do everything as well as certain other people do.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q59.explanationZh: “某些其他人”= certain other people；“和……一样好”用 as well as。

q60.sampleAnswer: She reminded me of what I should otherwise have forgotten.
references: She reminded me of what I should otherwise have forgotten.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: “提醒某人某事”= remind sb. of sth.；otherwise 放在 should 和 have done 之间，表示“要不是这样，本会……”。

q61.sampleAnswer: The girl students’ rooms are all in orderly condition.
references: The girl students’ rooms are all in orderly condition.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: orderly 是形容词“整齐的”，in orderly condition“处于整齐的状态”。

q62.sampleAnswer: In order to make his mother have a good rest, Xiao Wang cleaned the sink and the cupboard.
references: In order to make his mother have a good rest, Xiao Wang cleaned the sink and the cupboard.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: “为了……”= in order to + 动词原形，放在句首；make sb. do sth.“让某人做某事”。

q63.sampleAnswer: Don’t drink too many sugared beverages, or it is easy for you to gain weight.
references: Don’t drink too many sugared beverages, or it is easy for you to gain weight.
q63.rubricZh: 原书参考答案印作“Don’t drink too much sugared beverages, or it is easy for you to gain weight.”（beverages 是可数名词复数，应用 too many），经人工复核（GitHub #137）更正为现参考答案。

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: 祈使句 + or + 句子，表示“……，否则……”；“发胖”= gain weight。

q64.sampleAnswer: On the final stage, she remained calm and answered each of the questions her opponent fired at her, which won her rounds of applause.
references: On the final stage, she remained calm and answered each of the questions her opponent fired at her, which won her rounds of applause.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “对手”= opponent；“对手连珠炮似的提问”可用定语从句 the questions her opponent fired at her；which 引导非限制性定语从句指代前面整件事。

q65.sampleAnswer: I am glad to have this opportunity to visit your country.
references: I am glad to have this opportunity to visit your country.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “有机会做某事”= have the opportunity to do sth.。

q66.sampleAnswer: In my opinion, there should be a great change in our education system.
references: In my opinion, there should be a great change in our education system.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: “我认为”= In my opinion；“应该有……”= there should be ...。

q67.sampleAnswer: It is irresponsible to allow someone who hasn’t had professional training to operate the machine.
references: It is irresponsible to allow someone who hasn’t had professional training to operate the machine.
q67.rubricZh: 原书参考答案印作“It is not responsible to allow someone who hasn’t had professional training to operate the machine.”（“不负责任的”应为 irresponsible，not responsible 意为“不应负责”），经人工复核（GitHub #137）更正为现参考答案。

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: 用 it 作形式主语，真正的主语是 to allow sb. to do sth.；“操纵机器”= operate the machine；“不负责任的”= irresponsible。

q68.sampleAnswer: The environmental protection organisation appeals to the public to vote against this project.
references: The environmental protection organisation appeals to the public to vote against this project.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q68.explanationZh: “环保组织”= the environmental protection organisation；“呼吁某人做某事”= appeal to sb. to do sth.；“投票反对”= vote against。
